answer: A fresh key is a dark lantern: it throws no light because it holds no sealed verdicts. Standing comes only from quorum-matched grading seals re-checked on-ledger against consensus, accreting slow as a glacier, one honest judgment per epoch. That record cannot be minted or handed to a sibling; each honest grade sends a ripple of weight only its own key ever earned. A thousand clones each start dark and must grind the full seasons of judgment, so the sybil bill grows linearly with identities, never shared.
